name: simulify
description: Turn mechanisms, physical structures, protocols, math laws and algorithms into offline interactive 3D/4D explainers: cutaway views, scrubbable multi-act timelines, live equation substitution and what-if controls, built from a zero-build ESM kit.
author: yizhang-dream
suggestedPrompts: Build a 3D cutaway explainer of how a bimetallic thermostat switches, with a scrubbable timeline and an adjustable hysteresis band
Make an interactive multi-act workbench that shows LRU vs FIFO cache eviction side by side, with live hit-rate and AMAT formula substitution
Explain TD(0), Sarsa and n-step returns on a gridworld as a playable 3D chapter where I can rewind time and test counterexamples
